newsitem.title: POLAND: WARSAW BOURSE CHANGES TWO STOCKS IN WIG-20 INDEX.
newsitem.headline: WARSAW BOURSE CHANGES TWO STOCKS IN WIG-20 INDEX.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse added Animex and Optimus and withdrew Gorazdze and Rolimpex from the WIG-20 index of large-cap, high-volume stocks, a bourse official said on Tuesday.
Beata Mroz of the bourse's statistics department told Reuters that the new WIG 20, would be effective on January 16.
The other stocks of the WIG-20 include: Elektrim , Bank Slaski , BPH , BRE , WBK , BIG , Stomil , Wedel , Universal , Agros , Stalexport .
It also inscludes Mostostal Export , Okocim , Debica , Zywiec , Kety , Budimex and Polifarb Cieszyn .
The bourse updates the list quarterly.
